on_monthly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_RX_any_out }
		DA_RX_monthly = yes
	}
	if = {	# DA_EL (doc 72): a survey abroad whose ring is done reports
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_out
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_RX_surveying }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_reporting }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_RX_sv_reporting
		country_event = { id = DA_RX_event.61 }
	}
}

on_yearly_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_province = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_out } }
		set_country_flag = DA_RX_any_out
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ai = yes OR = { DA_EL_heritage = yes DA_LZ_heritage = yes } NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } any_owned_province = { DA_RX_site = yes } }	# DA_LZ (doc 73): the lizardfolk dig too
		country_event = { id = DA_RX_event.3 }
	}
}
